notes.title: Demolish & Build 3 Prologue - Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
[h2]🏗️The site is ready, and the deal is set on both ends.[/h2]

Turn up the radio and mood for the job as heavy equipment is coming to do the heavy lifting. Tools and materials provided, bring your safety gloves and shoes and mark the day.

[h3][b]Demolish & Build 3 Prologue is set to start construction works on 
March 1st, 2024.[/b][/h3]

🥾⛑️🦺🧤🎧⚠️👷✅Ok, you are ready to go.
[previewyoutube=x5cV7m8rwSc;full]https://youtu.be/x5cV7m8rwSc[/previewyoutube]
Demolish & Build 3: Prologue will include the first few missions of the full game and features:

🚧 Large excavator.
🚧 Skid steer.
🚧 Attachments
🚧 Physics-based track mechanics,
🚧 Vehicle controls based on real machines.
🚧 Full controller support,
🚧 Fully destructible objects and structures
🚧 Third-person and first-person camera modes,

A Basic Manual Training course for future foremen can be accessed on the main website in the form of a playable demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670/Demolish__Build_3/

Basic excavator training is also provided: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021130/Demolish__Build_3_Excavator_Playground/

Stay tuned for details of the contract. Stay cautious on the job site!

Dear Foremen,

Today is the day we lurk out of production to showcase what we were building in the last couple of months. Bringing this game together is a real challenge, but we are quite proud of what we have achieved so far and more than optimistic about what is to come.

In the upcoming weeks, we will share a little bit more of gamepad gameplay with vehicle controls and some other goodies.

We hope you'll enjoy it.

Yours,
Demolish & Build 3 Team.

notes.title: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/198defce7f6743073fade154f0989ada55815a80.jpg[/img][h2]This day has come![/h2]

[h1]Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground - play the demo now![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021130

[h2]Watch the trailer here:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=oC2o8nbJn9M;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground[/b] is a playable sneak peek at the driving and demolition physics from the upcoming [b]Demolition & Build 3[/b]. In the game, you take control of a modern excavator and drive around a small test track or demolish structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/f3f8843d4c8c474cc685d4ba756adb13b38f18c8.jpg[/img]

[b]Demolish & Build 3[/b] will include brand new demolition and driving physics. This short tech demo allows you to try them out before the final release.

[h2][b]The full version of the game - Demolish & Build 3 is coming in 2023.[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/4f5c69e21a993b6768d21cfed6e379ca121ce2c7.jpg[/img]

[b]Some of the main features of Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground include:[/b]
[list] 
[*] A large excavator equipped with demolition shears
[*] Vehicle controls based on real excavators
[*] Vehicle controls based on real excavators
[*] Physics-based track mechanics
[*] Full controller support
[*] Fully destructible objects
[*] A small test track
[*] Ramps
[*] Concrete structures that can be demolished
[*] Third-person and first-person camera modes
[*] And more…
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/c27cb6d9cfdc3c68cc4b0ea8264dce899bb2b20d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Play the demo now and send us your feedback![/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/mp9fys3268][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26225940/2e8a36948df3ac59a88c8b713340816a0c19bf76.png[/img][/url]

Cheers!
Demolish Games Team
